description: This PHP class 'PayGrade' extends 'FilterField' and implements 'ValueXNormalizable'. It provides functionality for filtering based on PayGrade within the OrangeHRM reporting system, including building query conditions and converting pay grade data into array form.

classes.name: PayGrade
classes.description: Class for filtering records based on PayGrade within reporting filters. Implements methods to modify query builder and to represent the filter value as an array.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds a where condition to the query builder based on the pay grade if the operator is 'EQUAL' and the filter value is not null.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the entity alias used in the query, which is 'salary'.

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Retrieves the PayGrade entity by ID and returns an array with its 'id' and 'label', or null if not found.
